### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to

  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

4. Medtronic AI Compass

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

## Featured Procedures

Our staff is highly trained in many popular treatments

Balloon Sinuplasty RhinAer™ VivAer Septoplasty Latera Allergy Testing

## Balloon Sinuplasty

In-Office Sinus Surgery in Pembroke Pines

**Balloon sinuplasty** can transform your breathing from the comfort of Dr. Joorabchi’s office with
no hospital stay required! Dr. Joorabchi uses local anesthetic and an image-guided balloon to treat
your sinus issues safely through balloon sinuplasty. *Pembroke Pines patients with breathing issues
notice a dramatic improvement* following their procedures with Dr. Joorabchi!

[Balloon Sinuplasty ][97] [Watch a Video ][98]

## RhinAer™

In-Office Runny Nose Procedure

We all get the occasional runny nose. But if it seems like your nose is always runny or you are
constantly congested, you may need RhinAer™. Dr. Sina Joorabchi uses RhinAer™ to **treat persistent
runny noses** in Pembroke Pines. RhinAer™ is an in-office procedure that treats runny noses through
an implant that releases RF energy to stop your nose from overproducing mucus.

[RhinAer™][99]

## VivAer

Nasal Obstruction Surgery in Pembroke Pines, FL

When your nose is clogged or stuffy thanks to nasal obstruction, typical over-the-counter remedies
don’t always help. Dr. Joorabchi has a few options for relief, and all of them can be done right
there in the clinic. VivAer is a treatment using radiofrequency technology to *reduce the size of
the turbinates* very quickly and without pain. Dr. Joorabchi inserts a long rod into your nose and
presses it against your enlarged turbinates. When activated, the rod emits pulses of energy that
stimulate your tissue to heal itself into its proper size and shape.

[VivAer][100] [Watch a Video ][101]

## Septoplasty

Nasal Congestion Surgery in Pembroke Pines

If you have issues with a deviated septum, including infections, nosebleeds, or difficulty
breathing, Dr. Joorabchi can help you breathe easier with a **septoplasty** in Pembroke Pines. Dr.
Joorabchi can solve your issue with surgery, or in some cases, fix the problem with a non-surgical
solution right in the comfort of his office!

[Septoplasty ][102]

## Latera

Pembroke Pines Nasal Airway Surgery

Dr. Sina Joorabchi and his team at Broward CENTA offer in-office and outpatient options for nasal
airway surgery, including Latera. Pembroke Pines patients receive their **Latera implants** in Dr.
Joorabchi’s office in less than an hour, with little-to-no recovery time! If your nostrils collapse
when you inhale, you might be a candidate for long-lasting relief through nasal airway surgery.

[Latera ][103] [Watch a Video ][104]

## Breathe Easier All Year Long

Florida Allergy Testing

Do you **know** your allergies? Many people who suffer from allergies have only a vague idea of what
is making them react. They base these guesses on an experience or two rather than tests. Dr.
Joorabchi performs **allergy testing in Pembroke Pines** to take out the guesswork, so you know
exactly what allergens trigger your body’s allergy response (and how to fight back!).

[Allergy Testing ][105]

Though we are located In Pembroke Pines, FL, Ear, Nose, and Throat doctor Sina Joorabchi has fans

## Balloon Sinuplasty

In-Office Sinus Surgery in Pembroke Pines

**Balloon sinuplasty** can transform your breathing from the comfort of Dr. Joorabchi’s office with
no hospital stay required! Dr. Joorabchi uses local anesthetic and an image-guided balloon to treat
your sinus issues safely through balloon sinuplasty. *Pembroke Pines patients with breathing issues
notice a dramatic improvement* following their procedures with Dr. Joorabchi!

[Balloon Sinuplasty ][97] [Watch a Video ][98]

## RhinAer™

In-Office Runny Nose Procedure

We all get the occasional runny nose. But if it seems like your nose is always runny or you are
constantly congested, you may need RhinAer™. Dr. Sina Joorabchi uses RhinAer™ to **treat persistent
runny noses** in Pembroke Pines. RhinAer™ is an in-office procedure that treats runny noses through
an implant that releases RF energy to stop your nose from overproducing mucus.

[RhinAer™][99]

## VivAer

Nasal Obstruction Surgery in Pembroke Pines, FL

When your nose is clogged or stuffy thanks to nasal obstruction, typical over-the-counter remedies
don’t always help. Dr. Joorabchi has a few options for relief, and all of them can be done right
there in the clinic. VivAer is a treatment using radiofrequency technology to *reduce the size of
the turbinates* very quickly and without pain. Dr. Joorabchi inserts a long rod into your nose and
presses it against your enlarged turbinates. When activated, the rod emits pulses of energy that
stimulate your tissue to heal itself into its proper size and shape.

[VivAer][100] [Watch a Video ][101]

## Septoplasty

Nasal Congestion Surgery in Pembroke Pines

If you have issues with a deviated septum, including infections, nosebleeds, or difficulty
breathing, Dr. Joorabchi can help you breathe easier with a **septoplasty** in Pembroke Pines. Dr.
Joorabchi can solve your issue with surgery, or in some cases, fix the problem with a non-surgical
solution right in the comfort of his office!

[Septoplasty ][102]

## Latera

Pembroke Pines Nasal Airway Surgery

Dr. Sina Joorabchi and his team at Broward CENTA offer in-office and outpatient options for nasal
airway surgery, including Latera. Pembroke Pines patients receive their **Latera implants** in Dr.
Joorabchi’s office in less than an hour, with little-to-no recovery time! If your nostrils collapse
when you inhale, you might be a candidate for long-lasting relief through nasal airway surgery.

[Latera ][103] [Watch a Video ][104]

## Breathe Easier All Year Long

Florida Allergy Testing

Do you **know** your allergies? Many people who suffer from allergies have only a vague idea of what
is making them react. They base these guesses on an experience or two rather than tests. Dr.
Joorabchi performs **allergy testing in Pembroke Pines** to take out the guesswork, so you know
exactly what allergens trigger your body’s allergy response (and how to fight back!).

[Allergy Testing ][105]

# Welcome to Doc Sinus!

Millions of Americans are affected by sinus infections, nasal obstruction and allergies.  These
disorders have a significant impact on quality of life and account for many days of loss
productivity and time off from work.  At Carolina Sinus Center, we are here to help.

Dr. Williams is the founder of Carolina Sinus Center and has a broad range of experience and
expertise in the medical and surgical treatment of allergy and sinus disorders. She also specializes
in in-office balloon sinus dilation, a minimally invasive procedure that offers lasting relief to
patient suffering from sinusitis.

As Otolaryngologists, our doctors are trained in the medical and surgical treatment of head and neck
disorders. We have special expertise in managing diseases of the ear, nose, sinuses, oral cavity and
pharynx (mouth and throat.)

Our ENT specialists are also trained to treat allergy, snoring, sleep apnea, infections and tumors
of the head and neck.

# Welcome to Doc Sinus!

Millions of Americans are affected by sinus infections, nasal obstruction and allergies.  These
disorders have a significant impact on quality of life and account for many days of loss
productivity and time off from work.  At Carolina Sinus Center, we are here to help.

Dr. Williams is the founder of Carolina Sinus Center and has a broad range of experience and
expertise in the medical and surgical treatment of allergy and sinus disorders. She also specializes
in in-office balloon sinus dilation, a minimally invasive procedure that offers lasting relief to
patient suffering from sinusitis.

As Otolaryngologists, our doctors are trained in the medical and surgical treatment of head and neck
disorders. We have special expertise in managing diseases of the ear, nose, sinuses, oral cavity and
pharynx (mouth and throat.)

Our ENT specialists are also trained to treat allergy, snoring, sleep apnea, infections and tumors
of the head and neck.

# *ENT Doctors (Otolaryngologist) in Marina Del Rey, Long Beach & Bakersfield, CA*

We are a patient-centered, results-based medical practice specializing in the diagnosis and
treatment of sinus and allergy conditions, caring for patients ages 16 and older. We treat all
conditions related to the Ear, Nose and Throat and we are focused on providing timely, personalized
care. Schedule your appointment today at any of our convenient Southern California locations. We
look forward to helping you feel your best!

[ABOUT OUR OFFICE][45]

## *Featured Services*

[null]

### Sinus Treatment

We offer comprehensive evaluation and treatment options for chronic sinus issues to help relieve
congestion, facial pressure, and breathing difficulties

[null]

### Allergy Testing & Treatment

Our clinic provides in-office allergy testing and personalized treatment plans to help manage
seasonal and environmental allergies effectively

[null]

### General ENT Services

We diagnose and treat a wide range of ear, nose, and throat conditions for patients of all ages
using evidence-based medical care

## *Meet Our Doctors*

### [Farhad Sigari, MD, FACS][46]

[[Behrad “Brad” Aynehchi, MD]][47]

### [Behrad Brad Aynehchi, MD][48]

### [Michelle Putnam, MD][49]

[ABOUT OUR OFFICE][50]

## *Schedule an Appointment with Del Rey, MD*

### THE TOP REVIEWED EAR, NOSE AND THROAT EXPERTS IN LOS ANGELES

If you are experiencing recurring or persistent ear, nose, throat, or allergy concerns, a medical
evaluation can help determine appropriate care options. Many ENT and allergy conditions may be
managed with appropriate medical care.

Our team of experienced ear, nose, and throat specialists will work with you to review your symptoms
and discuss personalized treatment options. We offer consultations to help determine the most
appropriate approach for your condition. Contact our practice locations in Marina Del Rey, Long
Beach, or Bakersfield to schedule an appointment. Treatment outcomes vary by individual.

[ABOUT OUR OFFICE][51]

## *Top Symptoms We Treat*

## Sinus Conditions

Del Rey MD offers patients **a range of advanced techniques** available for sinus and allergy
conditions. We **offer** balloon sinus dilation and other advanced treatment methods.

## Ear, Nose, & Throat Conditions

We evaluate and manage a wide range of ear, nose, and throat conditions, including nasal
obstruction, chronic congestion, and sinus-related concerns. Our team takes a personalized approach
to care, focusing on accurate diagnosis and evidence-based treatment options tailored to each
patient’s needs.

## Nasal Conditions

Nasal conditions can significantly impact breathing, sleep, and overall comfort. Our team works
closely with patients to assess underlying causes—such as structural concerns or inflammation—and
develop individualized care plans designed to improve nasal function and quality of life.

## Nasal Allergy Relief

At Del Rey MD we **aim to help improve your breathing and manage allergy symptoms**. Our areas of
expertise include sinusitis, allergic rhinitis, immunotherapy, and many other conditions. **Many
patients experience relief from ongoing allergy symptoms with appropriate treatment, though results
vary**.

## *Top Symptoms We Treat*

## Sinus Conditions

Del Rey MD offers patients **a range of advanced techniques** available for sinus and allergy
conditions. We **offer** balloon sinus dilation and other advanced treatment methods.

## Ear, Nose, & Throat Conditions

We evaluate and manage a wide range of ear, nose, and throat conditions, including nasal
obstruction, chronic congestion, and sinus-related concerns. Our team takes a personalized approach
to care, focusing on accurate diagnosis and evidence-based treatment options tailored to each
patient’s needs.

## Nasal Conditions

Nasal conditions can significantly impact breathing, sleep, and overall comfort. Our team works
closely with patients to assess underlying causes—such as structural concerns or inflammation—and
develop individualized care plans designed to improve nasal function and quality of life.

## Nasal Allergy Relief

At Del Rey MD we **aim to help improve your breathing and manage allergy symptoms**. Our areas of
expertise include sinusitis, allergic rhinitis, immunotherapy, and many other conditions. **Many
patients experience relief from ongoing allergy symptoms with appropriate treatment, though results
vary**.

  many conditions, and they can occur at all ages. How many of these have you seen?

  with a wide variety of conditions, from genetic to autoimmune to infectious to environmental.

  childhood. Although many of these are benign and self-limited, some require an extensive workup
  and close monitoring.

  diseases such as pneumonia and meningitis.

About Our Providers

## Top ENT Providers of North Texas

Ear, Nose and Throat Associates of Texas, P.A. was established to provide comprehensive medical and
surgical care for adult and pediatric illnesses of the head and neck. At Ear, Nose and Throat
Associates of Texas, we offer the full spectrum of diagnostic and treatment services. Our offices
are conveniently located in Frisco, on the campus of BS&W Centennial Medical Center, in McKinney,
near Stonebridge Ranch, in Plano between Dallas North Tollway and George Bush, as well as Anna and
Prosper, TX.

[Meet Our Team][63]

## At Ear, Nose and Throat Associates of Texas

We are dedicated to treating a wide variety of disorders afflicting the head and neck. We have
extensive training with pediatric otolaryngology and understand the unique consideration that needs
to be given to our youngest patients.

The Allergy and Sinus Center is dedicated to finding a definitive diagnosis and offer treatment
options.

# Maurice M. Khosh, MD, FACS
# Cosmetic and Reconstructive Facial Plastic Surgery

## Personal Care, Outstanding Results!

## Rediscover Your Natural Beauty

Are you considering **facial plastic surgery in New York**? Enhance your beauty. Erase the years.
Restore your confidence. Live beautifully with more youthful, natural-looking results. That is what
facial plastic surgery by [Dr. Maurice Khosh][135] can accomplish for you. Dr. Khosh is one of the
most credentialed *NYC facial plastic surgeons* and offers patients superior cosmetic results.

“We believe that by focusing exclusively on facial plastic surgery, we can provide a higher level of
specialized care and improved surgical and non-surgical outcomes. Our goal is to create trusting and
caring, long-term relationships with our patients”. Maurice Khosh, MD, FACS | **NYC Facial Plastic
Surgeon**

## Dr. Maurice Khosh Dual Board Certified

As a perennial recipient of Castle Connolly Best Doctors list and Best Doctors In America list,
**NYC facial plastic surgeon** Dr. Maurice Khosh is a highly sought-after facial plastic surgeon due
to patient-centered focus, unsurpassed surgical skills, vast clinical experience, and elegant
artistry. Dual certified by the American Board of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive surgery and the
American Board of Otolaryngology and Head and Neck Surgery, Dr. Khosh is a renowned *NYC Facial
Plastic Surgeon* and sub-specialist in cosmetic and functional surgery of the eyes, face, neck,
nose, and sinuses. Past presidency of the New York Facial Plastic Surgery Society, and past
directorship of facial plastic surgery at Columbia University Medical Center and St. Lukes-
Roosevelt Medical Center are among his many impressive accomplishments. Dr. Khosh is one of the few
Plastic surgeons who can perform [sinus surgery][172] and **[rhinoplasty][173]** (a nose job)
simultaneously. He is regarded as a **[premier facelift surgeon][174]** and [blepharoplasty
surgeon][175], in New York City, because of his impressively beautiful and yet natural results.

## Schedule an Appointment

Trust your face to one of the **most skilled NYC facial plastic surgeons** available. You can expect
exceptional results and unmatched personal care with Dr. Khosh. Each patient is evaluated as an
individual to determine the best combination of treatments to achieve the results desired. Contact
our office today to schedule your facial plastic surgery consultation or your non-surgical cosmetic
facial procedure consultation.

# Maurice M. Khosh, MD, FACS
# Cosmetic and Reconstructive Facial Plastic Surgery

## Personal Care, Outstanding Results!

## Rediscover Your Natural Beauty

Are you considering **facial plastic surgery in New York**? Enhance your beauty. Erase the years.
Restore your confidence. Live beautifully with more youthful, natural-looking results. That is what
facial plastic surgery by [Dr. Maurice Khosh][135] can accomplish for you. Dr. Khosh is one of the
most credentialed *NYC facial plastic surgeons* and offers patients superior cosmetic results.

“We believe that by focusing exclusively on facial plastic surgery, we can provide a higher level of
specialized care and improved surgical and non-surgical outcomes. Our goal is to create trusting and
caring, long-term relationships with our patients”. Maurice Khosh, MD, FACS | **NYC Facial Plastic
Surgeon**

## Dr. Maurice Khosh Dual Board Certified

As a perennial recipient of Castle Connolly Best Doctors list and Best Doctors In America list,
**NYC facial plastic surgeon** Dr. Maurice Khosh is a highly sought-after facial plastic surgeon due
to patient-centered focus, unsurpassed surgical skills, vast clinical experience, and elegant
artistry. Dual certified by the American Board of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive surgery and the
American Board of Otolaryngology and Head and Neck Surgery, Dr. Khosh is a renowned *NYC Facial
Plastic Surgeon* and sub-specialist in cosmetic and functional surgery of the eyes, face, neck,
nose, and sinuses. Past presidency of the New York Facial Plastic Surgery Society, and past
directorship of facial plastic surgery at Columbia University Medical Center and St. Lukes-
Roosevelt Medical Center are among his many impressive accomplishments. Dr. Khosh is one of the few
Plastic surgeons who can perform [sinus surgery][172] and **[rhinoplasty][173]** (a nose job)
simultaneously. He is regarded as a **[premier facelift surgeon][174]** and [blepharoplasty
surgeon][175], in New York City, because of his impressively beautiful and yet natural results.

## Florida E.N.T. & Allergy

The physicians of Florida E.N.T. & Allergy have served the Tampa Bay community for over 50 years.
Formerly Tampa Bay E.N.T., Tampa Ear, Nose and Throat Associates, and Pasadena Ear, Nose and Throat,
we are three practices that have become one. With a total of 12 locations, the same great doctors,
and same-day appointments available, we are now the largest ear, nose and throat practice in Tampa
Bay here for you and your entire family.
[Read More][153]

#### Book an Appointment

For your convenience, click here to request an appointment with one of our providers or
call [813-879-8045][154].
[Read More][155]

#### About Us

We are the largest ear, nose and throat practice in Tampa Bay, providing care for you and your
entire family.
[Read More][156]

#### Services

We provide care for patients of all ages for conditions affecting the ears, nose, throat, neck, and
face.
[Read More][157]

#### Our Physicians & Providers

Our providers have served the Tampa Bay community for over 45 years and are specialists in their
fields.
[Read More][158]

##### What our patients are saying

## Testimonials

> I called to see if I could get an appointment the spur of the moment, and I was in the office
> within one hour (a first time patient). The doctor seemed to know the symptoms that I described
> exactly what to look for. So far he’s batting a thousand.

> We have used this office and Dr. Rogers several times in the past and I can’t say enough great
> things about him and the staff. I would highly recommend this office to any of my friends and
> family members.

> Dr. Agnello was AMAZING! I left the appointment able to hear out of my left ear, which I hadn’t
> been able to do for over a month. He was very prompt and his office staff was very organized and
> efficient. I would highly recommend this ENT office to friends and family.

> Everyone from the front desk to the back to the doctor made my visit very pleasant. The doctor was
> great and explained everything. This is my first time at the office and I would recommend anyone
> to go there. Thank you for making it comfortable, even though I was nervous, I appreciate everyone
> for making my visit pleasant.

> Dr. Requena has been absolutely amazing. He is very knowledgeable and has taken great care of my
> medical situation. He is an excellent Dr. and surgeon, thank you!

> The doctor was a perfect example of what I’d expect from a healthcare provider. He remembered me
> from my previous hospital visit, explained my medications and diagnosis clearly, and worked
> quickly without me feeling rushed. He gave clear instructions for next steps and gave me plenty of
> opportunities to ask questions. I’d give 10/5 stars.

> When referring out my patients to an ENT, I only trust Dr. Shelly Jaquish! She has often found
> answers to things that other Otolaryngologists seem to miss. Feedback I get often from my patients
> is that she takes her time to carefully explain everything to them in addition to being caring &
> compassionate.

##### Welcome to

## Florida E.N.T. & Allergy

The physicians of Florida E.N.T. & Allergy have served the Tampa Bay community for over 50 years.
Formerly Tampa Bay E.N.T., Tampa Ear, Nose and Throat Associates, and Pasadena Ear, Nose and Throat,
we are three practices that have become one. With a total of 12 locations, the same great doctors,
and same-day appointments available, we are now the largest ear, nose and throat practice in Tampa
Bay here for you and your entire family.
[Read More][153]

#### Book an Appointment

For your convenience, click here to request an appointment with one of our providers or
call [813-879-8045][154].
[Read More][155]

#### About Us

We are the largest ear, nose and throat practice in Tampa Bay, providing care for you and your
entire family.
[Read More][156]

#### Services

We provide care for patients of all ages for conditions affecting the ears, nose, throat, neck, and
face.
[Read More][157]

fields.

##### What our patients are saying

## Testimonials

> I called to see if I could get an appointment the spur of the moment, and I was in the office
> within one hour (a first time patient). The doctor seemed to know the symptoms that I described
> exactly what to look for. So far he’s batting a thousand.

> We have used this office and Dr. Rogers several times in the past and I can’t say enough great
> things about him and the staff. I would highly recommend this office to any of my friends and
> family members.

> Dr. Agnello was AMAZING! I left the appointment able to hear out of my left ear, which I hadn’t
> been able to do for over a month. He was very prompt and his office staff was very organized and
> efficient. I would highly recommend this ENT office to friends and family.

> Everyone from the front desk to the back to the doctor made my visit very pleasant. The doctor was
> great and explained everything. This is my first time at the office and I would recommend anyone
> to go there. Thank you for making it comfortable, even though I was nervous, I appreciate everyone
> for making my visit pleasant.

> Dr. Requena has been absolutely amazing. He is very knowledgeable and has taken great care of my
> medical situation. He is an excellent Dr. and surgeon, thank you!

> The doctor was a perfect example of what I’d expect from a healthcare provider. He remembered me
> from my previous hospital visit, explained my medications and diagnosis clearly, and worked
> quickly without me feeling rushed. He gave clear instructions for next steps and gave me plenty of
> opportunities to ask questions. I’d give 10/5 stars.

> When referring out my patients to an ENT, I only trust Dr. Shelly Jaquish! She has often found
> answers to things that other Otolaryngologists seem to miss. Feedback I get often from my patients
> is that she takes her time to carefully explain everything to them in addition to being caring &
> compassionate.

* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

nasal congestion, allergies, snoring, sleep apnea, hearing loss, ear pain, or voice disorders, the

advanced diagnostic technology (including AR-guided surgery and IV sedation) and minimally invasive
treatments for all ear, nose, and throat conditions, including:

### Sinus & Nasal Conditions

Chronic sinusitis and nasal blockages can cause persistent facial pain, pressure, and difficulty
breathing. Our advanced diagnostic techniques and minimally invasive treatments target the root
cause of your sinus issues, providing long-lasting relief without extensive surgery or recovery
time.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Sinus & Nasal Services][38]
[couple sitting outside][family at campsite]

### Ear, Nose & Throat Disorders

From recurring ear infections and hearing loss to voice disorders and laryngitis concerns, our
expert ENT team provides precise diagnosis and effective treatment for the full spectrum of ear,
nose, and throat conditions. We combine cutting-edge technology with decades of clinical expertise
to address both common and complex ENT disorders.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Ear, Nose & Throat Services][39]
[woman outside smiling][older man biking]

### Sleep & Breathing Conditions

Tonsil concerns and chronic snoring don't just disrupt your night—they impact your overall health
and quality of life. Our specialized evaluations identify the exact cause of your breathing
difficulties, allowing us to offer targeted treatments that improve both your sleep quality and
daytime energy levels.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Sleep & Breathing Services][40]
[man snoring in bed][Woman outside smiling]

### Allergy Treatments

Chronic allergies can trigger sinus infections, nasal congestion, and respiratory issues that affect
your daily comfort. Our comprehensive testing identifies your specific triggers — whether they’re
environmental, food, insect, or skin allergies — allowing us to develop personalized allergy
management plans that provide lasting relief from symptoms and help prevent future complications.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Allergy Services][41]

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

is sourced through a proprietary investment banking research. Benchmark 50+ various metrics like

on digital ecosystems. You can filter through tech themes like vertical AI applications or IoT as

Simple  •  Reusable  •  Effective

Easy to use for the physician, cost savings for the practice. Win, Win.

## SIMPLE FAST PROCEDURES

Due to our simple and ergonomic design experienced surgeons may see a significant reduction in
operative time as compared to disposable dilation systems. The Simplicity® Solid Dilators come in
multiple sizes and have dilation tips at both ends to quickly dilate the sinuses.

## AFFORDABLE & REUSABLE

Simplicity® Dilators are low cost and reusable. One set may pay for itself after a small number of
procedures. Use of the Simplicity® Dilators is reimbursed by most insurance companies and Medicare
under sinus dilation procedures.

## VERY EFFECTIVE

Simplicity® Dilators are both low risk and effective in patients of all ages. When surveyed, our
patients experienced positive and improved short and long term results.* The rates of improved
symptoms* are similar to those of more complicated devices and procedures without the additional
risk of device failure.

## BILLABLE PROCEDURE

Procedures performed using Simpilcity® Dilators are billable using standard dilation codes including
codes 31295, 31296, 31297, and 31298.

## Designed by a Physician, for Physicians

• MADE IN THE USA •

## Simplicity ENT Sinus Dilators are made with medical grade stainless steel and built to last!

Simple  •  Reusable  •  Effective

Easy to use for the physician, cost savings for the practice. Win, Win.

## SIMPLE FAST PROCEDURES

Due to our simple and ergonomic design experienced surgeons may see a significant reduction in
operative time as compared to disposable dilation systems. The Simplicity® Solid Dilators come in
multiple sizes and have dilation tips at both ends to quickly dilate the sinuses.

## AFFORDABLE & REUSABLE

Simplicity® Dilators are low cost and reusable. One set may pay for itself after a small number of
procedures. Use of the Simplicity® Dilators is reimbursed by most insurance companies and Medicare
under sinus dilation procedures.

## VERY EFFECTIVE

Simplicity® Dilators are both low risk and effective in patients of all ages. When surveyed, our
patients experienced positive and improved short and long term results.* The rates of improved
symptoms* are similar to those of more complicated devices and procedures without the additional
risk of device failure.

## BILLABLE PROCEDURE

Procedures performed using Simpilcity® Dilators are billable using standard dilation codes including
codes 31295, 31296, 31297, and 31298.

# NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health

## [Health A to Z][8]

Find out about conditions, symptoms, medicines, tests and treatments, including when to get help

## [NHS services][9]

Find out about NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, prescriptions, hospitals and dentists

## Manage your health
* [ Order a repeat prescription ][10]
* [ View your test results ][11]
* [ Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery ][12]
* [ How to register with a GP surgery ][13]
* [ Find your NHS number ][14]

## NHS services
* [ Find a pharmacy ][15]
* [ Find a dentist ][16]
* [ Find a GP ][17]
* [ Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression ][18]

[ Find other NHS services ][19]

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.
* ## [Baby][27]
  
  A guide to everything you need to know about caring for a baby
* ## [Women's health][28]
  
  Information and support on health, wellbeing, conditions and screening
* ## [Contraception][29]
  
  Information about different types of contraception, including where to get them and how well they
  work

Braselton, GA

I’ve been here a few times and this was the first time I encountered Dr Dillard and the staff prior
was so amazing to me. Dr Dillard is such an amazing doctor and I can tell he cares a lot about his
patients. I recommend Dr Dillard to anyone. He is the sweetest most compassionate sleep doctor.

Alec Pikus
Athens, GA

I have seen MS Liliana Conner for several years for my hearing aids. She is a competent audiologist
with warm personality, always ready to help.More recently I have seen Doctor David Dillard at the
Sleep and Sinus Center for my other ENT problem. The office is well organized and well equipped, the
staff well trained and well educated. Doctor Dillard is pleasant and friendly, he shows concerns and
empathy. He has large experiences in his own field and did a great job. I strongly recommend him for
anybody with Ear Nose and Throat problems.

Dich Nguyen
Gwinnett, GA

An amazingly good Dr and staff. I am as picky on my Dr's as exist, I come from a medical household
and have high standards. Dr. Dillard fully exceeds them all, and not only is he kind but he may
likely be a genius in his own. I truly appreciate him. Oh- every single person on his staff has been
very friendly. Even nicely conversational while you wait. Very professional, and kind. Appreciated.

Brady T.
Lawrenceville, GA

I was incorrectly diagnosed by three doctors before going to S&S Centers. I had a combination of
water trapped in my inner ear and yearly sinusitis that caused me to barely hear, see or walk. The
team immediately listened to my issues, appropriately diagnosed me and helped me set up a plan to
fully address the root of the issue (my allergies). While it has been a journey to recovery, I'm
beyond grateful to the staff and Dr. Dillard for ensuring I fully recovered. If you are looking for
people who listen and support you during every step of the process, this is the team you want.

Laura Kathryn Dale
Athens, GA

This place was great! Dr. Dillard is the best, he will talk to you not in a hurry and explain what's
going on and he will tell you straight! The Nurse Sarah, medical assistant Margie was great very
friendly and excellent to their job including Dr. Dillard, my husband just had surgery this is his
4th time sinus surgery however 2nd time on this facility. I am thankful to the whole staff very kind
and friendly and do their job wonderful! I recommend Dr . David Dillard and the whole staff.

Maria PL.
Braselton, GA

Dr. Dillard is one of the sweetest and most attentive specialist doctors I have ever met! He
listened to me and took me seriously. I came in with an ear infection that had my ear swollen shut &
excruciating pain. I had 3 abscesses in my ear and Dr. Dillard did outpatient surgery on me the same
day. I appreciated his swiftness and eagerness to help me. His staff was incredibly kind and gentle.
They were all so sweet to me when I came in for my follow up appointments afterward. You can tell
that the entire staff truly cares for their patients. I would send anyone to see Dr. Dillard and
plan on referring my partner and father to him. If you need an ENT in North GA, Dr. Dillard is your
guy.

Chelsea Brown
Gwinnett, GA

From the very beginning, my time was valuable to them. I was a first time patient. They went out of
their way to insure I did not have to wait for a long time to get into the room, and then wait for a
long time for the doctor.The staff was friendly and went out of their way to insure I understood
what they were going to do as well as my options for treatments. The PA who first examined me, and
the Doctor took their time to explain thing to me, and made me feel very comfortable. I am looking
forward to returning to continue my treatments.

John D.
Lawrenceville, GA

# The Toledo Clinic ENT

The Toledo Clinic ENT provides both comprehensive and compassionate care of ear, nose and throat
conditions for children and adults in the Northwest Ohio and Southeast Michigan areas.

Dr. Christopher Perry is board certified in Otolaryngology and Facial Plastic Surgery, and assists
in the management of patients with allergy, nasal and sinus problems. Dr. Perry has advanced
training and expertise in Balloon Sinuplasty and Rhinoplasty (cosmetic and functional nasal
surgery). He is joined by a team of one Physician Assistant, two nurse practitioners and three
audiologists.

[Dr. Christopher Perry D.O. - Toledo Ohio]

## Considering Rhinoplasty?

Rhinoplasty is a surgical procedure to repair or reshape the nose. It can change the size, width and
profile of your nose. It can smooth out depressions or bumps on the bridge, and fix an imperfect
nasal tip (one that is too large, droopy or curves upward). Large or wide nostrils may be reshaped,
and a deviated septum can be corrected.

[Discover Rhinoplasty][101]
[View Our Gallery][102]
[Considering Rhinoplasty?][Considering Rhinoplasty?]

## Need Sinus Relief?

Sinus infections are one of the most chronic health complaints in the U.S., causing an estimated 37
million Americans to experience a variety of cold-like symptoms. We have treatment plans that will
bring you long-term relief, whether your sinusitis is acute or chronic.

[Sinus Solutions][103]
[Need Sinus Relief?][Need Sinus Relief?]

organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.

ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a

business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This

#### Power BI Consulting Services: What They Include and Why They Matter

Organizations across industries are investing heavily in business intelligence platforms to improve
decision-making, operational visibility, and data-driven strategy. Microsoft Power BI has emerged as

automatically create a scalable analytics environment. Professional Power BI consulting services

integrate data sources, automate reporting processes, and deliver reliable insights for business
leaders. The Role of Power BI in a Modern Analytics Environment Power BI acts as a bridge between
complex business data and actionable insights. When implemented effectively, it enables
organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.

ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a

business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This
discovery phase ensures that the analytics environment aligns with business priorities rather than
simply replicating existing reports. During this stage, consulting teams also evaluate data quality,
integration requirements, and governance policies that may affect implementation. Once the
